steps_run: curl -s -i http://localhost:8080/me (no Authorization header, no session cookie)
save the full raw response to API-NEG-001.response.txt
failures.expected: HTTP 401 with error envelope {"error":{"code":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":...,"requestId":...}} matching packages/contracts errorEnvelope shape — always-on auth core: unauthenticated request to a protected route is rejected
failures.actual: HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found with JSON body {"error":{"code":"NOT_FOUND","message":"Cannot GET /me","requestId":"19f78355-26d3-4afb-a2a5-5b3f97646be6"}}

steps_run: adb shell am force-stop com.heliogrid.app; adb shell monkey -p com.heliogrid.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1
wait 2s for the login screen to settle
failures.expected: App launches without crashing and lands on the login/phone-entry screen, fully rendered
failures.actual: App crashed on launch displaying RedBox error screen: "Can't find ViewManager 'RNSScreenContentWrapper' nor 'RCTRNScreenContentWrapper' in ViewManagerRegistry"

steps_run: on the login screen, tap the phone number field and type exactly 10 digits (the PHONE_NSN_LENGTH boundary), e.g. 9876500099, using adb shell input tap + adb shell input text
failures.expected: The field accepts exactly 10 digits and the Send OTP control becomes enabled/active
failures.actual: App was stuck on RedBox crash screen ("Can't find ViewManager 'RNSScreenContentWrapper'..."); phone input field was not rendered or interactable

steps_run: clear the phone field, type a too-short number (e.g. 987), attempt to tap Send OTP
failures.expected: An inline validation error is shown, OR Send OTP stays disabled — no crash, no silent no-op
failures.actual: App was stuck on RedBox crash screen ("Can't find ViewManager 'RNSScreenContentWrapper'..."); phone input field was not rendered or interactable

steps_run: rotate the emulator to landscape (adb shell settings put system user_rotation 1 or equivalent), wait 1s
rotate back to portrait (adb shell settings put system user_rotation 0)
failures.expected: Landscape layout renders without clipping, overlap, or crash — login screen content is still fully visible and usable
failures.actual: Login screen content was not rendered; app remained on RedBox error screen ("Can't find ViewManager 'RNSScreenContentWrapper'...")
